theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the ranked leader and trend-gate eligible (score 1.43, durability_bar 0.56), with breadth of 0.429 suggesting participation beyond a single name and no crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate — the one validated leg — is satisfied, so the staying-power risk control favors this theme as the incumbent leadership; but because rank-IC is ~0 and the lead over Gold is only 0.088, this is a modest relative-to-benchmark lean, not a conviction buy.
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated as drawdown control (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Hurst is 'mixed', and the thin margin to Gold plus non-trend breadth means leadership could stall; the positive rank is a coincident focus lens, not forward alpha.

theses.subject: Big Banks

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is crowded (crowding_z 1.17, crowded true) despite a negative score (-0.193), and guardrails forbid fading the leader but permit flagging crowding as a sizing caution; an 'avoid' lean reflects staying out of a crowded lagging theme while the trend gate offers no positive case. It is eligible but its Hurst is mixed and score is negative, so there is no validated reason to be long it here.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a down-size caution, not a sell
theses.dissent: Breadth is the highest in the table (0.7), and crowding alone might not justify avoidance if an AI/tech macro pulse (present in macro_narrative) re-accelerates the theme.
